# Ge Yu (余舸)

> Personal academic website of Ge Yu, Ph.D. Candidate in Finance at the Swedish House of Finance, Stockholm School of Economics (Stockholm, Sweden). Research interests: financial intermediation, machine learning and AI, empirical asset pricing, and FinTech.

Contact: ge.yu@hhs.se · Office 671/674, Sveavägen 65, 113 50 Stockholm, Sweden

- [About](https://geyu.me/): Bio, works in progress, and education history

- [Teachings](https://geyu.me/teaching/): Courses taught or assisted at the Stockholm School of Economics

- [Job Market Paper](https://geyu.me/jmp/): Redirect to the latest draft PDF

## Research

- Job market paper: "From Words to Portfolios: Disentangling Narrative and Reality in Mutual Fund Differentiation" — develops a deep-learning model to construct two measures of mutual fund differentiation (portfolio holdings vs. prospectus narratives); finds narrative differentiation works as a marketing and pricing tool while genuine portfolio differentiation generates alpha. Latest draft: https://geyu.me/jmp/
- Working paper: "Heterogeneous Investor Beliefs in the Age of AI"

## Education

- Ph.D. in Finance, Stockholm School of Economics (2021–present)
- M.S. in Applied Economics and Management, Cornell University (2019–2021)
- B.A. in Public Finance, Central University of Finance and Economics (2015–2019)
